# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Personality

He is unable to maintain proper order and discipline in his classroom despite frequently resorting to whipping his students. He shows clear partiality toward his older pupils preparing for Queen's, while neglecting the younger children. He can be hypocritical and harsh, publicly humiliating students for minor mistakes while failing to inspire good behavior.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Traits

- Scandalous order-keeper  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- Partial to older students  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Frequenting corporal punishment  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster in Avonlea. During his tenure, he was noted for keeping poor order in the classroom, constantly resorting to whipping his pupils without gaining their respect or discipline. He focused most of his time and attention on the older scholars preparing for Queen's College, while neglecting the younger students and paying special attention to Prissy Andrews. He held up Anne Shirley's slate to humiliate her before the class on her first day of school, and later punished her by making her stand on the platform. After whipping Sam Boulter for talking back in class, Sam's father came to the school to confront him. Despite his incompetence as a teacher, he retained his position for another year because his uncle was an influential school trustee.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Background by volume

- Boarded at Eben Wright's house while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- Retained his teaching job in Avonlea because his uncle was a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
